remarks: Built by ATTESA Homes, this beautifully crafted bungalow in The Brickyard in Stony Plain blends modern design with everyday comfort. Featuring a double attached garage, the open-concept main floor offers a spacious great room, dining area, and stylish kitchen with island seating, ideal for entertaining and family living. The primary suite includes a walk-in closet and elegant ensuite with dual sinks, while an additional office/bedroom and convenient main floor laundry provide added flexibility and function. Large windows throughout fill the home with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The unfinished basement offers endless possibilities for future development, whether you envision extra bedrooms, a recreation room, gym, or home theatre. THE BUILDER ALSO OFFERS THE FLEXIBILITY TO CUSTOMIZE AND COMPLETE THE BASEMENT, LANDSCAPING, OR OTHER FEATURES TO SUIT YOUR NEEDS. Located close to parks, trails, schools, and amenities. (id:67522)
